culture-cycles.note: State holidays only; the nine nationwide holidays (in 2027: 1 Jan, 26 and 29 Mar, 1 May, 6 and 17 May, 3 Oct, 25 and 26 Dec) are on Germany's record. Several 2027 dates fall on a weekend, and there is no substitute weekday.

laws.rule: In Travemünde (Lübeck), overnight visitors pay a spa levy (Kurabgabe) per person per day: EUR 3.50 from 15 May to 14 September (about A$5.56, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) and EUR 2 the rest of the year; it includes the beach fee. Lübeck's old town and other districts charge no overnight tax.
